title: Material Library catalogue export
description: One document with the whole catalogue (GET /v1/export?format=json). Every entry of records is a UMR v2 document and validates against material.v2.json on its own; this envelope only adds the version, the moment and the count so a file is self-describing.

schema_version.description: Contract version of the records, not of the envelope.

exported_at.description: UTC timestamp of the export, the same value as the X-Exported-At header.

count.description: Number of records in the file; the same value as the X-Record-Count header.
